criteria.requirement: Register typed_list(item_check="string", force=True, min=None, max=None) in Validator using the same instance registered checks. Accept list/tuple or, only when force is true, one scalar; never split a string into characters. Normalize force from schema true/false, enforce lengths, convert every element with Validator.check, return a fresh list and keep input unchanged. Add VdtListItemError with zero-based index and original cause, excluding the original value from its message. Preserve custom check behavior and all existing force_list/int_list/None checks; a real ConfigObj configspec must use this validator.
